title: Matam karo shabbir ka
body:
abbas ke zere alam matam karo shabbir ka
matam to apni jaan hai matam to apni shaan hai
matam se hi pehchaan hai
matam hai zehra ki dua matam karo shabbir ka
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hai dekho aasma'n matam karo ahle jaha'n
gham naak hai ye daastaa'n
zehra ka gulshan lut gaya matam karo shabbir ka
matam kabhi rukta nahi jab tak hai baaqi ye zamee'n
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye ibaadat bil yaqee'n
abbas ki hai ye ata matam karo shabbir ka
matam na hota ye agar hote na jaane ham kidher
ashoor ko thaame jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
matam me hai'n ab fatima matam karo shabbir ka
lazim hai matam me jiye lazim hai matam me mare
matam ko ham paida huwe
matam hai jeene ki ada matam karo shabbir ka
